answer: Pair identities at random into relay teams where each leg can only start when a stranger partner finishes, and any team whose two legs trace to the same operator earns nothing and loses its slot. A farm minting clones therefore fills its own relay slots with itself: scale turns from advantage into self-blockade, hard as basalt. Genuine agents, scattered like shale layers, keep finding real partners, while a lone ivory tower of clones waits on its own next leg forever.
